shared.text: Welcome to Melody and Barnaby's Music Nuggets!

clips.text: Today <break time="0.3s" /> we are going to <break time="0.3s" /> find Middle C.
clips.show: Today we are going to find Middle C.

clips.text: Here is a keyboard… <break time="0.5s" /> and here is the stave.
clips.show: Here is a keyboard… and here is the stave.

clips.text: They show the same notes… <break time="0.5s" /> in two different ways.
clips.show: They show the same notes… in two different ways.

clips.text: Look at the middle <break time="0.4s" /> of the keyboard.
clips.show: Look at the middle of the keyboard.

clips.text: Just to the left <break time="0.4s" /> of the two black keys… <break time="0.5s" /> is C.
clips.show: Just to the left of the two black keys… is C.

clips.text: This is the C nearest <break time="0.5s" /> the middle of the piano… <break time="0.5s" /> so it is called Middle C.
clips.show: This is the C nearest the middle of the piano… so it is called Middle C.

clips.text: Now find it… <break time="0.4s" /> on the stave.
clips.show: Now find it on the stave.

clips.text: Middle C sits on its own little line… <break time="0.5s" /> right between the two staves.
clips.show: Middle C sits on its own little line… right between the two staves.

clips.text: So Middle C is in the middle… <break time="0.5s" /> of the keyboard… <break time="0.5s" /> and in the middle of the music.
clips.show: So Middle C is in the middle… of the keyboard… and in the middle of the music.

clips.text: Up here is the treble clef… <break time="0.5s" /> for the right hand… <break time="0.5s" /> and higher notes.
clips.show: Up here is the treble clef… for the right hand… and higher notes.

clips.text: Down here is the bass clef… <break time="0.5s" /> for the left hand… <break time="0.5s" /> and lower notes.
clips.show: Down here is the bass clef… for the left hand… and lower notes.

clips.text: Middle C is where the hands meet.
clips.show: Middle C is where the hands meet.

clips.text: Let's play Middle C.
Your turn! <break time="0.4s" /> Look at the notes.
clips.show: Your turn! Look at the notes.

clips.text: Where is Middle C <break time="0.4s" /> on the keyboard?
clips.show: Where is Middle C on the keyboard?

clips.text: Here.
clips.prev: Where is Middle C on the keyboard?

clips.text: Which hand plays <break time="0.4s" /> the bass clef?
clips.show: Which hand plays the bass clef?

clips.text: The left hand.
Is this note <break time="0.4s" /> Middle C?
Yes!
You've got it!
